preview.modelExplainer: Our model emphasizes approach play and total strokes gained, which together account for over half the weighting. Birdie/bogey ratio also carries a 0% weight, highlighting the importance of capitalizing on scoring opportunities.

article.title: TOUR Championship Model Targets: Bridgeman, Bhatia, Scheffler Lead East Lake Rankings
article.dek: Model ranks Bridgeman #1, Bhatia #2, Scheffler #3 for the 30-player field at East Lake Golf Club.
article.introduction: The tournament model places Jacob Bridgeman at rank 1 with 933 SG Total, Akshay Bhatia at rank 2 with 646 SG Total, and Scottie Scheffler at rank 3 with 868 SG Total. East Lake weights SG APP at 7% and SG PUTT at 0%, aligning with the top three players' combined strengths in those categories. All three carry the same contextual profile: skipped the Scottish Open, zero tracked rounds in the major swing, and safe FedExCup top-50 status.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The 30-player TOUR Championship at East Lake carries course weights of SG APP 7%, SG PUTT 0%, and SG TOTAL 0%. The model ranks the top 20 players by weighted SG TOTAL, with Bridgeman 933), Scheffler 868), and Bhatia 646) occupying the first three spots.

keyTakeaways.text: Bridgeman leads the model at rank 1 with 1.933 SG Total and 1.339 SG PUTT, the highest putting mark among the top 20.
Bhatia ranks 2nd in the model with 1.646 SG Total and 0.792 SG APP, the strongest approach game among the three picks.
Scheffler sits 3rd in the model at 1.868 SG Total and 0.623 SG OTT, the best off-the-tee figure of the trio.
All three players share identical research flags: DID_NOT_PLAY at the Open, skipped the Scottish Open, and zero tracked major-swing rounds.
East Lake's 28.7% SG APP weight favors Bhatia's 0.792 mark and Scheffler's balanced 0.08 SG APP alongside elite SG OTT.
